commercial_product.business_description: Operator of approximately 185 outpatient diagnostic-imaging centers across 13 states (second-largest US outpatient imaging platform by center count), performing about 30 million scans per year. Modalities include MRI, CT, PET/CT, mammography, ultrasound, and X-ray. Operates Connexia teleradiology service and multiple health-system joint ventures (Baylor Scott & White, Intermountain, Integris, Atrium, Virtua, Tenet, Tucson Medical Center, UPMC).
commercial_product.regulatory_status: Service-business model; no proprietary drugs or devices subject to FDA premarket approval.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Outpatient diagnostic-imaging services company (radiology center operator) - no proprietary drug or device clinical pipeline.
